topic: Classification of Dysarthria based on the Levels of Severity. A Systematic Review
topic_definition: Stage 1 observable projection of the original paper's eligibility. Use title and abstract evidence to judge whether the study concerns dysarthria severity-level classification or assessment, including intelligibility as a severity-related signal when visible. Full-text-only confirmation is deferred to Stage 2.
summary: Stage 1 title/abstract projection of source-faithful Stage 2 criteria; publication-time fallback filtering is handled by cutoff_jsons/2310.07264.json.

summary_topics.description: Classification of Dysarthria based on the Levels of Severity. A Systematic Review

required.criterion: Title/abstract indicates that the study concerns dysarthria and classification or assessment.
Title/abstract indicates severity levels, severity classification, severity assessment, intelligibility assessment, or another explicit link between intelligibility and dysarthria severity.
When dysarthria classification is visible but severity or intelligibility evidence is incomplete at title/abstract level, keep maybe and defer final confirmation to Stage 2.

exclusion_criteria.criterion: Title/abstract clearly indicates a review or survey paper.
Title/abstract clearly indicates a general motor-speech-disorder chapter or study not specifically about dysarthria severity classification.
Title/abstract clearly focuses on other disorders such as dysphagia or dementia rather than dysarthria severity.

Title/abstract clearly describes rehabilitation or therapy software, automatic recognition/detection/identification of dysarthria without severity levels, feature-impact-only analysis, or binary dysarthric-vs-control classification rather than severity-level classification.
